name: Exage LX 7-speed combined shift/brake pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 305 g for the complete ST-M050 four-finger left/right combined-control pair. The 1991 400LX table explicitly states four-finger type pair, resolving the previously unqualified 1992 figure. ST-M050-S is not assigned this mass.

specifications.weight_reference_note: The selected 305 g pair remains based on the explicitly paired 1991 400LX table. The 1990 table labels its 305 g entry Rear; that earlier entry is not doubled or used to redefine the selected pair.
